name: Compaction Handoff Guard
summary: Record bounded, content-free receipts before and after conversation compaction.
description: A deterministic fail-open PreCompact and PostCompact observer that records only byte counts and SHA-256 digests in a bounded toolkit-owned local state file.
risk_reason: This observer records bounded, content-free receipts before and after conversation compaction; it writes only bounded local receipts and cannot block the event.
refuses: It does not store transcript text, compacted summaries, custom instructions, or session identifiers.
It does not block automatic or manual compaction when a receipt cannot be written.
It does not claim that matching digests prove semantic completeness of the compacted summary.
It does not write outside the bounded toolkit-owned project state file.

entrypoints.purpose: Persist bounded content-free receipts around context compaction for local audit continuity.

operational.latency_reason: To record bounded, content-free receipts before and after conversation compaction, the entrypoint reads or writes bounded local state before returning.
